PC Errata 2018 E card of [[Program Trap]]: A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018). Source: Holotable image Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Dark/large/programtrap.gif, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 swccgpc/holotable commit 022435b] (8 July 2018), the repository's first import of the image set. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive] Shown on [[Program Trap (PC Errata 2018 E card)]].
